purpose: Compare current frozen policy and controls on a real directed road topology with synthetic task streams.

network.sampling: 100 grid positions snapped to distinct nearest nodes in the largest strongly connected drivable component
network.travel: directed shortest-path road length divided by 300 metres per abstract distance unit and the vehicle's generated speed
network.travel_interpretation: fixed synthetic per-vehicle speed, equivalent to 27-45 km/h; no traffic, turns or signal delays
network.network_scope: OSMnx drive filter; static network; 0.01-degree routing buffer; fixed snapshot in data

uplink: fixed upload delay, as in the primary reference contract
method_order: rotated deterministically by seed and profile; one fresh policy and environment per method
primary_metric: on-time completed value / released value, paired by seed and profile
uncertainty: two-sided, unadjusted paired Student t 95% intervals; wins/ties/losses use the exact integer completed values
audit: frozen resource checks and independently recomputed NetworkX road-distance action checks; store raw event and task traces
note: Pilot is limited to implementation checks; the comparison block is independent of pilot seeds and will be reported regardless of sign. Cells sharing a seed are related.
